svg.title: Wiring diagram for connecting a ZXpand+ serial connector to an FTDI-style USB serial adapter
svg.desc: Two dashed containers, one for the ZXpand+ connector pins GND, RX, and TX, and one for the FTDI adapter pins GND, RXD, and TXD. A straight line connects the two GND pins. Two diagonal lines cross between the boxes: ZXpand TX connects to FTDI RXD, and FTDI TXD connects to ZXpand RX, showing the required crossover.
